_note: State and national party handles, read by packages/core/src/breaking/parties.ts. The desk DOES tag parties on campaign and party-activity copy — @BJP4Rajasthan 42 posts, @INCRajasthan 39, @INCIndia 11, @BJP4India 7 across 1,002 published posts (30 Oct and 9-10 Nov 2026): 99 party tags that the old blanket 'election news tags nobody' guard dropped. A party handle is tagged beside the leader the copy names, NEVER beside a district police handle or a collector (handles.ts keeps those on separate classes). Keywords are matched as whole words, so short Latin keys like INC cannot fire on 'since' or 'incident'.
_clash_rule: Copy that names two parties ('कांग्रेस ने भाजपा पर साधा निशाना') tags NEITHER: the desk does not pick a side on an attack story, and tagging both burns the slot the leader should have.

Corroborated: the desk itself tagged @officialkharra on 2 of the 30 Oct posts (his vote in the panchayat poll), and @RajGovOfficial tags it (subject-handles.json). Avoid @jhabarkharrabjp / @JhabarKharraBJP: its bio says 'फैन पेज' (fan page), though the desk used it once on 30 Oct. scope 'mla' (user decision, 13 Nov 2026): OFFERED, unticked, whenever the copy names him; never tagged on the post, and naming him does not count as naming the party (parties.ts keeps MLA entries out of the party picks, the clash rule and the political hint). The person entry in subject-handles.json is kept (still HELD there, so it does not tag); if the desk verifies it there, that entry tags it and the offer is dropped (one entry per handle).
